summary: removesuffix returns the string without one exact matching suffix, or returns the original content when the suffix is absent.
documentation: removesuffix returns the string without one exact matching suffix, or returns the original content when the suffix is absent. It compares the complete suffix rather than treating its characters as a set.
returns: Names with one exact lowercase .csv suffix removed when present.
caution: Matching is case-sensitive. rstrip(".csv") removes any trailing combination of those characters and can damage a filename; removesuffix does not.
scenarios: Turn approved CSV filenames into report labels.
Remove one documented marker from an export name.
Strip a known filename extension before displaying a local import group.
title: Remove an exact export suffix
problem: For each filename, remove exactly one trailing lowercase .csv if present. Keep uppercase .CSV, interior .csv text, and all other characters unchanged.
goal: Use str.removesuffix() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
